derivation.reason: Conditional reader-ceiling arithmetic only: 493272 planned JSONL rows times 64 MiB = 33102923563008 logical bytes IF every producer row obeys the reader ceiling. There is no proof of that producer bound and no fit promise. All failures/caps remain retained.

physical_policy.method: One unchanged full engine call and original BSGS solve stage, separately guarded generator/candidate/baseline. Fresh wrapper sets its own kernel limits, installs SIGKILL parent-death handling and rechecks actual expected parent. Local unit parent applies 4 GiB address-space limit; this is not an aggregate RSS or cgroup claim.
physical_policy.current_machine_fit: No unconditional worst-case completion claim. Future admission must account configured hard per-file/tree/document/memory limits, free-byte reserve, other concurrent runs and root publication/readback. Any guard leaves unknown/incomplete data.
physical_policy.polling_qualification: Tree/free-space guards are monitored every10ms; not filesystem quotas or a hard bound on scheduler latency. Kernel per-file limits and native address-space guard remain. Parent preserves all bytes available after wait.
physical_policy.log_rule: Reader pauses on limit crossing until process group is terminated and reaped, then drains remaining bounded pipe bytes. No emitted bytes are deliberately dropped.
physical_policy.parent_documents: Bounded streaming JSON writer saves a prefix on an actual document-byte refusal; original output remains incomplete, never synthetically complete.
physical_policy.hard_upper_formula: No unconditional aggregate hard upper bound is established. Per-child RLIMIT_AS/FSIZE are kernel limits; tree/log/reserve guards poll. Future admission separately budgets raw engine files, generation, three guarded stages, all partial/failure cases, source-before/after captures, native/supervisor/observer logs, manifests, temporary files, delivery packing, root publication and full streamed GET verification.
physical_policy.native_extra_copies: Later native/archive/publication contract must count any copies. Supported no-local-duplicate route is root-authorized original-file upload plus uncached full GET STREAM SHA/byte verification; stream_payload uses at most declared chunk size and leaves raw originals untouched.
physical_policy.deletion: No raw spool retirement, remote write or credential use in v5.

historical_qualification: Actual old completion record only; no future bound, compression/RSS ratio or time estimate.
remaining_qualification: First actual fresh full-cohort execution and complete output counts are not performed in this source stage.
Future admission must supply sufficient declared resources or preserve a truthful resource stop.
No qualified total attack cost, native primitive replay, isolated clocks or peak RSS claim.
future_production_limits: Separately frozen configurable positive resource limits, within supported framing ceilings, must be supplied at future admission. Unit defaults do not promise production completion or that one/all three full cohorts fit.
unit_worker_guard: Final unit supervisor applies 4 GiB RLIMIT_AS and independently polls summed /proc resident pages for its actual descendant tree against 4 GiB, every20ms, with a 120-second outer watchdog. It retains all samples. This is a polling guard and sampled RSS observation, not a hard cgroup bound, exact peak RSS or production fit measurement.
integration_retention: Exact prior DEL160b reconstructed from its metadata plus unchanged base gzip pool with original sorted compact JSON+LF serialization. The old physical hardlink remains untouched. Cumulative union retains all prior7617raw files and source versions plus bounded incremental evidence; no3.7GBraw duplication or worker retirement.
native_custody: Observer is a separate PID via fresh PDEATHSIG wrapper; solver children inherit only their distinct release pipe, independently verified not to contain service socket FDs. Observer failure prevents success, closes workers and retains partials. Driver waits observer finalization before unchanged native checker.
